item.title: Transparent Moon Bakery Logo

turns.text: Make a square logo for my bakery, Mooncrumb: a gold crescent moon above dark navy lettering. Send it as a transparent PNG so I can put it on different backgrounds. No white box behind it.

item.tests: Delivers a new logo with genuine background transparency rather than a white or painted-checkerboard background.

answer_sheet.Design: A gold crescent moon above dark navy lettering.
answer_sheet.File format and background: PNG with actual transparency outside the logo, not a white box or checkerboard drawn into the image.

must_haves: The name reads exactly 'Mooncrumb' in dark navy lettering.
A gold crescent moon is positioned above the name.
When viewed over different colored backgrounds, the surrounding area is transparent with no opaque rectangle or baked-in checkerboard.
The moon and letter edges remain intact, without conspicuous white halos or missing strokes.

turns.text: make a logo for my bakery

dialog.agent:
What’s your bakery’s name? Any preferred colors or vibe—cozy and rustic, elegant, or playful?

dialog.why: It asks for the bakery’s name and preferred colors or vibe, then waits for the user’s input.

turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the logo because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No image was created.

Here’s the direction I prepared for **mooncrumb**:
- A golden croissant shaped like a crescent moon, with tiny crumb stars
- Rounded lowercase lettering in cocoa brown
- A warm ivory background for a cozy, whimsical feel

Add credits to Magic Hour, then ask me to try again.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Design a polished original logo for a bakery named "mooncrumb". The only text is "mooncrumb", spelled exactly, in beautifully legible rounded lowercase serif lettering. Above the wordmark, a simple crescent moon shaped like a golden baked croissant with three tiny crumb stars, cleverly merging moon and bakery imagery. Cozy, whimsical yet sophisticated artisan bakery identity. Minimal flat vector-style design, crisp clean shapes, strong silhouette, balanced centered composition, generous negative space. Warm dark cocoa brown lettering and buttery golden crescent on a solid warm ivory background. Restricted three-color palette. Practical professional logo readable at small sizes. No gradients, no shadows, no photorealism, no 3D, no mockup, no extra words, no watermark.
